title: Quick answers
subtitle: A few helpful details before you reach our team.

items.question: How can I check my order status?
items.answer: Call our support line or message us on WhatsApp with your registered phone number and order ID. Our team can help check the latest delivery update.

items.question: What should I do if an item arrives in poor condition?
items.answer: Contact support as soon as possible and include your order ID. A photo of the item or bill can help our team review the issue and guide you through the available options.

items.question: How do I report a late delivery?
items.answer: Use the hotline or WhatsApp dispatch option with your order ID. The support team can check the delivery status and advise you on the next step.

items.question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
items.answer: Contact support as soon as possible. Address changes depend on the order's dispatch status and whether the new address is within the service area.

items.question: How can I request a refund or replacement?
items.answer: Reach out with your order ID and a brief description of the issue. If relevant, attach a clear photo so the team can review your request.

items.question: When is customer support available?
items.answer: The contact options on this page show the listed support channels and their availability. For urgent delivery concerns, use the hotline or WhatsApp action.
